description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shambling Gast, adding {R}.
Mortuary, Shambling Ghast and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.
